verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document ("Fellow Developer API" v1.0.2). It is retrievable at a stable ReadMe api-registry URL, and llms.txt and per-page .md mirrors support machine consumption. The probes found no Fellow-branded spec path, but that only limits discoverability; it does not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: a discoverable Fellow-branded download link (developers.fellow.ai/openapi.json and similar paths return 404), any published API changelog or deprecation policy alongside the spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Fellow's Developer API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document ("Fellow Developer API", version 1.0.2, "Create custom integrations and workflows with Fellow's meeting data"; paths under /api/v1/)
the stable URL is ReadMe's api-registry endpoint
